title: Remote Automated Laboratory System (RALS) License
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY MEDICAL COMMAND.US ARMY HEALTH CONTRACTING ACTIVITY.W40M MRC0 WEST
description_text: Remote Automated Laboratory System (RALS) License in support of the Department of Pathology and Area Laboratory Services (DPALS) for Eisenhower Army Medical Center, Fort Gordon, GA 30905. The responsible offeror must submit: -Technical Description of items being offered -CLIN/Item Number Pricing (filled out) -Company’s Unique Entity ID (UEI) -CAGE code -Company Contact Information The information in SAM must be current and complete before an award can be made. Contractor shall not have any Active Exclusion Record in SAM.
